capabilities: Capture records, flash thoughts and todos from an overview panel
Write entries as Markdown list items into dedicated daily files
Filter and search entries by type, tag and keyword across all dates
Toggle todo completion and sync the checkbox marker back to the file
Show a 90-day activity heatmap of record counts
extras: Record type labels in the files are the Chinese tokens 记录 / 闪念 / 待办; a Chinese README is also provided. Uninstalling the plugin leaves the Markdown records in place.
problem: Quick thoughts and todos captured in Obsidian end up mixed into daily notes or a separate database, with no easy way to filter, search or review them by day.

relations.evidence: When on, ignores Obsidian's built-in Daily Notes config and uses the folder/format below

summary: Markdown-native daily capture panel that writes records, flash thoughts and todos to dedicated daily files, with filters, search and a heatmap.
